revisions.name: Kiwi’s Mobs
revisions.goal: Reference for communicating original mob abilities and traits through an in-game animated bestiary.
revisions.next: Prototype one original bestiary entry and verify that its animation preview, live behavior and visual state agree.
revisions.blockers: The observed file is an author-labeled beta, not an install recommendation or a tested build. The project description flags Minecraft 1.20.1 as unstable.
revisions.decisions: Preserve this exact game, loader and file baseline as a manual reference; recheck the author’s page for subsequent versions.
revisions.resources: The pinned author notes describe an Axolotl entry, structure previews and healing, fishing and combat-support behavior.
